entities.summary: Anne Bogart is an American theatre and opera director. She was one of the artistic directors of SITI Company, which she founded with Japanese director Tadashi Suzuki in 1992, until the company disbanded in 2022. She is a professor at Columbia University where she runs the Graduate Directing Concentration and is the author of four books of essays on theatre making: A Director Prepares; And Then, You Act; What's the Story; and The Art of Resonance. She is a co-author, with Tina Landau of The Viewpoints Book, a "practical guide" to Viewpoints training and devising techniques.
